title: GAP-12: Redundancy seam: P-N-AVB-INTERFACES is keyed in ADP only, not at the top, registry or counters (REQ-SCP-003)
body:
[A10] Found by the compliance-matrix audit of `docs/00_MILAN_COMPLIANCE_REVIEW.md` at main 6a878f6 (owner request, 2026-09-18). The matrix Cov column grades the ORIGINAL architecture document; this ticket records what the tree carries today. Baseline at that head: `./scripts/run_suites.sh` exit 0 (30 of 30 suites, 14790 checks), `./scripts/lint_hdl.sh` exit 0.

## Finding

GAP-12 (Minor), F00.2 verdict of this audit: **PARTIAL**.

- Resolution claimed in F00.2: Explicit non-redundant scope + parameterized seams
- "Addressed in" check: {'ok': True, 'note': "01_overview.md:14-16 states the non-redundant position (ch. 8 excluded, REDUNDANCY = 0, seams parameterized); F01.5 carries P-N-AVB-INTERFACES (:144, 'redundancy seam') and P-EN-REDUNDANCY (:175, must stay 0)."}
- "Verified by" claimed: DIR
- In `hdl/` today: Scope half implemented: MILAN_FEATURES_FLAGS = 0 (hdl/aecp/ucode/gen_ucode.py:104-112, emitted :701/:710); STREAM descriptors in Table 7-8 layout with number_of_redundant_streams = 0 (hdl/aecp/desc/example_milan_8.json:176-177, 205-206; hdl/aecp/KL_aecp_desc_store.sv:91-93). Seam half only partly: ADP is keyed by N_IF_P (hdl/adp/KL_adp_engine.sv:67, :101-106, :556-557) and the transaction carries interface_index (hdl/common/pp_pkg.sv:89), but the top has no interface-count parameter, pins .N_IF_P(1) (hdl/top/protocol_processor_top.sv:1569) and hardwires .rx_if_index_i(2'd0) (:1329); the registry does not store the port ('P-N-AVB-INTERFACES is 1 here, so the port field is constant and not stored', hdl/aecp/KL_aecp_notify.sv:17-20); no per-interface counter keying found.
- In `tb/` today: DIR for the scope half: tb/pp_top/sim_main.cpp:2247-2248 (M1 byte-exact GET_MILAN_INFO) and :2290 (M2 features_flags == 0, REDUNDANCY named at :2273-2276); tb/ucpu/sim_main.cpp:827 (P17). Seam half ungraded: tb/adp_engine/README.md:57-58 'runs the shipping shape (1 interface, 8 sinks) only'; no suite elaborates N_IF_P > 1.

## What remains

The explicit-scope half is closed with evidence. The 'parameterized seams' half is not what the RTL carries: only ADP is keyed; the top, the registry port field and the counters are fixed at one interface and no build ever exercises N_IF_P = 2. Either thread P-N-AVB-INTERFACES through (and elaborate it once in a suite or lint) or record the seam as closed by decision in 01 section 7 and REQ-SCP-003. Same work item as REQ-SCP-003 in slice-F.json.

## REQ-SCP-003 (Milan 5.3.4.2, 8, design) - audit verdict PARTIAL

Keep per-interface keying (registry, ADP, counters) parameterized as the redundancy seam

- In `hdl/` today: ADP is keyed: hdl/adp/KL_adp_engine.sv:67 (parameter N_IF_P = 1), :101-106 per-interface link/GM inputs, :556-557 adv_st_r [N_IF_P]; the transaction record carries interface_index (hdl/common/pp_pkg.sv:89) and the talker checks it (hdl/acmp/KL_acmp_talker.sv:375-376, :626). NOT keyed: the registry drops the port field (hdl/aecp/KL_aecp_notify.sv:17-20: 'P-N-AVB-INTERFACES is 1 here, so the port field is constant and not stored'); protocol_processor_top has no P-N-AVB-INTERFACES parameter at all, pins .N_IF_P(1) at hdl/top/protocol_processor_top.sv:1569 and hardwires .rx_if_index_i(2'd0) at :1329; no per-interface counter bank parameter was found in hdl/aecp/KL_aecp_engine.sv (AVB_INTERFACE hits are descriptor-type constants only, :628, :1011, :2921).
- In `tb/` today: tb/adp_engine/tb_adp_top.sv:23 exposes N_IF_P but the suite only ever builds the default: tb/adp_engine/README.md:57-58 'the suite runs the shipping shape (1 interface, 8 sinks) only'. No suite elaborates N_IF_P > 1; no registry test grades a port field (none exists).
- Missing: A top-level interface-count parameter (F01.5 P-N-AVB-INTERFACES) threaded to ADP, the registry and the counters; the registry row's port field (Milan 5.3.4.2 tuple {EID, MAC, port}); any elaboration or suite at N_IF_P = 2 proving the seam still elaborates and keys correctly. Same finding as GAP-12.
- Searched with: N_AVB|N_IF_P|N_IFACE|N_INTERFACES|AVB_INTERFACES (hdl/, tb/); if_index|iface|interface_index (hdl/); port|interface in hdl/aecp/KL_aecp_notify.sv; N_IF in tb/adp_engine (confidence: medium)

## Acceptance

1. protocol_processor_top exposes the interface count (F01.5 P-N-AVB-INTERFACES) and passes it to KL_adp_engine instead of the literal 1 at :1569
2. KL_aecp_notify stores the port per registry row when the count is > 1, or the banner and 01 section 7 record the seam as closed by decision
3. One suite or lint-only elaboration builds N_IF_P = 2 so the seam cannot rot unnoticed
4. REQ-SCP-003 Arch cell names what is and is not keyed
5. KL_aecp_notify either stores the port per registry row when the count is > 1 or the banner and 01 section 7 record the seam as closed by decision
6. One suite (adp_engine or a lint-only elaboration) builds N_IF_P = 2 and passes, so the seam cannot rot unnoticed
7. docs/00 REQ-SCP-003 Arch cell names what is and is not keyed

Executor and reviewers: assigned when the lane opens.
